s: September 24, 2025 - Shinobu Kocho (胡 (こ) 蝶 (ちょう) しのぶ, Kochō Shinobu?) was a major supporting character of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba. She was a Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps and the Insect Hashira (蟲 (むし) 柱 (ばしら) , Mushi Bashira?) of the Taisho era.[2][3] She was also the younger sister of the former Flower Hashira Kanae Kocho, and the adoptive older sister of Kanao Tsuyuri.
